requirements.text: Messages are stored before sending and retried with backoff; they are marked dead after a maximum number of attempts
One business event sends at most one email, including with concurrent dispatchers and provider retries
Recipient addresses and headers are validated and header injection is refused
Hard bounces and complaints suppress later sends to that address
Provider webhooks are signature-verified before parsing, mapped to message status and safe to replay
Provider API calls use timeouts, pass an idempotency key and classify retryable versus permanent failures

evidence.name: retry classification, full-jitter backoff with injected random, and dead after maxAttempts
enqueue renders, stores and is idempotent per key
concurrent dispatchers never send the same message twice
suppression list: checked at enqueue and again at send
webhook adapter: signature before parsing, event mapping, replay
Resend transport: request shape, Idempotency-Key header and status classification
